# Nominatim (recorded: 2026-11-06)

Real answers of `https://nominatim.openstreetmap.org` (© OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL 1.0), one request every 2 s, User-Agent `skill-osint (fixtures)`, with `accept-language=fr`: `search-4-place-de-l-hotel-de-ville-75004-paris.json`, `search-lyon.json`, `reverse-48.8565,2.352.json` (Hôtel de Ville), `reverse-48.8584,2.2945.json` (Eiffel Tower), `reverse-38.5725,-7.9075.json` and `reverse-38.5728,-7.9076.json` (Roman temple of Évora), `status.json`. `reverse-45.9012,2.7021.json` is invented (the demo's fictional bakery). The engine asks `accept-language=en` or `fr` after the case's language; the fake server ignores it, so the French answers serve both.

The Géoplateforme answers (`../geopf/`, Licence Ouverte) of the same day: `search-4-place-de-l-hotel-de-ville-75004-paris.json`, `search-lyon.json`, `reverse-48.8565,2.352.json`; `reverse-45.9012,2.7021.json` is invented.
